description: Find companies by their equity vesting characteristics: vesting/equity type (e.g. "RSU"), vesting shape (frontloaded, backloaded like Amazon, linear, one/two/three_year, or extended 5+ years), total years, and whether there's a 1-year cliff. Returns matching companies (most data-rich first) with their decoded vesting schedules.

hasCliff.description: Filter by whether the schedule has a 1-year cliff.

vestingPattern.description: Filter by vesting shape: frontloaded, backloaded (e.g. Amazon), linear (equal each year), one_year / two_year / three_year (total length), or extended (5+ years).

vestingType.description: Filter by vesting/equity type substring, e.g. "RSU", "Stock Options".

name: search-companies-by-vesting
